title: The Land Laid Waste

questions.question: To whom did the word of the Lord come?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:1 (ESV): "The word of the Lord that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel."

questions.question: What has the cutting locust left?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:4 (ESV): "What the cutting locust left, the swarming locust has eaten."

questions.question: Awake, you drunkards, and weep, and wail, all you drinkers of what?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:5 (ESV): "Awake, you drunkards, and weep, and wail, all you drinkers of wine,"

questions.question: For a nation has come up against my land, powerful and beyond number; its teeth are what?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:6 (ESV): "its teeth are lions' teeth, and it has the fangs of a lioness."

questions.question: The vine dries up; the fig tree languishes. Gladness dries up from whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:12 (ESV): "surely gladness dries up from the children of man."

questions.question: Tell your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children to whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:3 (ESV): "and their children to another generation."

questions.question: Lament like a virgin wearing sackcloth for the what of her youth?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:8 (ESV): "Lament like a virgin wearing sackcloth for the bridegroom of her youth."

questions.question: The grain offering and the drink offering are cut off from where?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:9 (ESV): "The grain offering and the drink offering are cut off from the house of the Lord."

questions.question: Consecrate a fast; call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the Lord your God, and do what?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:14 (ESV): "and cry out to the Lord."

questions.question: Alas for the day! For the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from whom shall it come?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:15 (ESV): "and as destruction from the Almighty it comes."

questions.question: Whatever the swarming locust has left, the hopper has eaten; what the hopper has left, the what has eaten?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:4 (ESV): "what the hopper has left, the destroyer has eaten."

questions.question: It has laid waste my vine and splintered my fig tree; it has stripped off their bark and thrown it down; their branches are made what?
Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Go in, pass the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God! Why?
options: Because grain offering and drink offering are withheld from the house of your God
questions.correctAnswer: Because grain offering and drink offering are withheld from the house of your God
questions.explanation: Joel 1:13 (ESV): "because grain offering and drink offering are withheld from the house of your God."

questions.question: The seed shrivels under the clods; the storehouses are desolate; the granaries are torn down because the grain has what?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:17 (ESV): "because the grain has dried up."

questions.question: Even the beasts of the field pant for you because the water brooks are dried up, and fire has devoured the what?
questions.explanation: Joel 1:20 (ESV): "and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness."

key_verse_text: Alas for the day! For the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from the Almighty it comes.
